What to Know About the Apple Outage

Thousands of users have reported experiencing issues on Tuesday with several of Apple’s services, including Apple Pay, iCloud, and Apple Support. Apple attributed the problems to an internal update and said that it was in the process of addressing them as of Tuesday afternoon.
